text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One peaceful afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No waaayyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, abso-lutely not! There's 
just no way!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ah! Perfect timing! You tell Nature too~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tell her to take pictures for the "PR" 
Squad together!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Remember how we were running around 
acting as the academy's PR squad without 
permission?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, apparently word of that reached the 
Chairwoman. And so—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo and the gang got offishally 
appoynted for real! We gotta take super 
cool pictures!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: And yet Nature says no way! Whyyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Because... that kind of thing really isn't 
my style, it's way too heavy a burden for 
me, and anyway—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's just impossible!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: She ran away! Get herrr!!
choice_data_list: Wait, she ran in the opposite direction!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
This way is fine for Turbo! You go chase 
Nature first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I hurriedly gave chase to Nice 
Nature, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ——... Trainer, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, why are you the one chasing after me? 
What happened to Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Turbo is... right here... Found 
you... Nature~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why are you completely exhausted 
too? What kind of development is this?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... The kinda development... where 
Nature... takes pictures... too...!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're still on about that...? Why are you 
trying so desperately hard anyway?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
'Cause Nature, you weren't running away 
for real...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo knows it! When Nature's serious, 
she's way faster than that!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So deep down, you actually wanted to get 
caught, right? Then Turbo's gonna be "it" 
and chase you down!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, what kind of logic is that? 
There's no way... I wanted to get caught.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I just can't do it. I can't 
sparkle on camera like Teio and the others 
do...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Then just be yourself in the picture!? 
Turbo likes the usual Nature best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right, that's right. Let's take 
them together, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You guys... why?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
We are to participate in a photo shoot for 
promotional purposes, correct? Turbo-san 
just informed us a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...! Did you bring them here just for my 
sake...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nature, look, look! Model pose! Nyun!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nyu...? What kind of model pose is that 
even supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is her wholehearted pose, chosen 
after much deliberation. Would you like to 
try it as well, Nature-san? It helps 
relieve tension in the shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. That's...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature, you're happy, aren't you! We're 
all together, so you wanna take them now, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft, sheesh, all of you. You're trying 
way too hard.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...If I refuse now, I'll just look like 
the bad guy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Twin Turbo and the others went 
into the school promotional photo shoot 
together—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aweeesome! Super awesome! Turbo and the 
gang look so cool!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't stare at it so much, it's 
embarrassing! Jeez...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature! Turbo put up pictures of us all 
over the academy and the town!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaahhh?! Ah jeez, I knew I shouldn't 
have taken them!!
